page.overview:
What is Attack on Corellia?

A Nihil attack occurred in Coronet City on Corellia in the Core Worlds in 230 BBY as part of the infiltration on Corellia. The attack was only launched when the bodyguard Prybolt Garavult grew suspicious of the meeting his client, Father of Finances Nomar Tralmat, was involved in and feared for the man's life. In reality, Tralmat was having a meeting with his Nihil allies, only for Garavult's entry to risk the public learning of his secret alliance. As such, Tralmat ordered Sabata Krill to kill the bodyguard. Because Garavult was able to get a hologram message about the Nihil out to his boss and friend Alys Ongwa, kicking off a series of events that made the Jedi Order and Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection aware of the Nihil's infiltration on Corellia. Tralmat also used the incident as a chance to fake his death. During the Battle of the Corellian Shipyards, Tralmat revealed himself to be alive, only to be killed later in the battle by Mother Fastidima when she learned he was behind Garavult's death.
